entities.name: Luís Roberto Barroso
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Luís Roberto Barroso is a Brazilian law professor, jurist, and retired Justice of the Supreme Federal Court of Brazil, having been nominated to the position by President Dilma Rousseff in 2013. Between 2020 and 2022, Barroso also served as President of the Superior Electoral Court.
